rules.why: The GPU overview and the chart panels GPU Nodes and GPU Pods open page a fixed number of node and host boxes inside a page that scrolls on purpose, so the footers have no rows-per-page choice.

Cluster View draws every node in the map and pages the node boxes under it by their pod cards (at most 200 cards and 10 boxes a page, a node of more pods going on on the next page); a box can be taller than the screen, so the page scrolls on purpose and the footer has no rows-per-page choice.
